newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia city of Townsville on cyclone alert.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia city of Townsville on cyclone alert.

text.p: The Australian port of Townsville has been placed on alert for a cyclone expected to hit land nearby later in the day, port officials said on Monday.
Cyclone Ita is forecast to cross the north Queensland coast between the communities of Cardwell and Bowen near Townsville, the Bureau of Meteorology said.
A port spokesman said activity was continuing at the port, although operations have been put on "yellow alert, the second most severe of four categories.

Nickel producer QNI Ltd was monitoring weather conditions from its Yabulu refinery about 25 km east of the port but operations were continuing, Bob Wardhaugh, general manager of the refinery, told Reuters.
"The storm is still a distance away, but nevertheless we're monitoring developments," Wardhaugh said.
Three ships were in the port on Monday, including a bulk carrier laden with nickel ore for QNI, a naval vessel, and one other ship, the port spokesman said.
A spokesman for MIM Holdings Ltd said he was not aware of any disruptions at the company's copper refinery in Townsville.
The region is also a major sugar cane growing area.
The cylcone is carrying heavy winds and gusts up to 100 km an hour, the Bureau of Meteorology said.
